draft.shortGloss: to pull, to drag; to drag out, to delay
draft.emotion: a steady, focused effort, applying physical strength to shift something heavy
notes: Imperfective; perfective: потянуть (to give a pull) or вытянуть (to pull out, stretch).
Differentiate from тащить, which emphasises hauling something heavy or with effort.
